text.description: Text for the interface: a string (in the assistant's language) or an object language → text. K-Desktop uses its language if it is there, otherwise English or the first one.

key.description: Key of a setting or of a piece of data (camelCase; with dots to nest: «pilot.level»).

id.description: Lowercase identifier: letters, numbers, dots and hyphens.

packagePath.description: Relative path inside the package, with forward slashes and without «..».

icon.description: Picture of the package (relative path) or a K-Desktop symbol («kd:Name»).

hotkey.description: Shortcut in K-Desktop's format: «CTRL + ALT + L».
